rappel_detail.anchor: natural: horn, block, or a sling around a chockstone or tree; no bolts reported
rappel_detail.station: The loosest, most exposed step on the upper south face of the Middle Peak.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional short single-rope rappel; most parties downclimb the whole face. A single 30 m rope, or half a 60 m, is plenty.

set.rappels: Usually none: most parties downclimb. 1 optional short rappel on a 30 m rope over the loosest step on the upper face
